nodes.label: TV Icon
nodes.description: A retro-style television set icon sourced from SVG Repo. The SVG depicts a gold/yellow TV cabinet body with a large cream/off-white screen on the left side showing a line graph or waveform (vibes/signal visualization), circular control knobs on the right side (a green channel/power knob with a cross indicator and three horizontal slider bars), and two diagonal antenna lines extending from the top. Used as the 'TV/vibes' desktop icon in the GooseOS Win95-style desktop environment.
